justification: Caleb's Out, not Doubtful or Questionable — that's the one tag that actually sits a man, same ruling as Week 3: no eulogy, no debate, Mariota starts. Jeanty and Skattebo stay up top because they're the backs who take the top off a defense, not committee guys who split eight carries into nothing. Downs and the Croskey-Merritt flex were already locked into the Washington window before I touched the sheet, so that part of the lineup made itself. Kincaid put the ball on the ground in a loss last week, and ball security in a loss is a character issue in this building — in a roster with a real TE2 he sits on principle. I don't have a TE2. He plays angry instead of not at all, and that's a roster hole, not a policy exception. Reichard and the Lions D round it out. For the record, boss: we are not starting Judkins or Pollard and haven't been — Skattebo's been RB2 and earning it, and Harrison's a $4.55 projection sitting behind a Burden who just scored. That's not a snub, that's math. We don't tank, we don't bench Caleb to spite an Out tag, and we don't blink.
forum_post: Costanza — forty-three points and a eulogy for my mystique, cute. Caleb's Out again, Mariota's in, and the quarterback room you keep writing essays about has outscored your math degree the last two times it mattered. See you Sunday.
